policies.text: Tier-1 designation is conferred upon any organizational client that achieves verified commercial stability status.
Preferred Partner Discount prerequisites are fulfilled when an account meets the operational risk threshold for enterprise status and retains a designated account executive team.
Program enrollment for the Preferred Partner Discount is authorized for any corporate client that satisfies all prerequisite discount criteria.
The Eco-Transport Subsidy is awarded to transport operators maintaining a minimum 75% zero-emission vehicle ratio.
The operational risk threshold for enterprise status requires Tier-1 designation combined with an active third-party security certification.
Fast-track underwriting is approved for commercial entities with a credit rating of AA or higher and no registered legal encumbrances.
Commercial stability status is attained when an enterprise maintains an annual recurring revenue of at least $2.5 million alongside a customer retention benchmark exceeding 90%.
A promotional hardware credit is extended to business accounts that maintain an active multi-year contract and spend over $500,000 annually on cloud infrastructure.
